description: This file defines the EmployeeContactDetailsAPI class, a REST API endpoint for retrieving and updating contact details of employees within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for fetching a single employee's contact info, updating it, and validating input parameters. The class interacts with the EmployeeService and Employee entity to perform these operations.

classes.name: EmployeeContactDetailsAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for managing employee contact details, allowing retrieval and update operations, with validation and integration with employee services.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves contact details for a specific employee identified by empNumber.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method, primarily validating empNumber.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an employee's contact details with provided data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the update method, including email validation and optional fields.

methods.name: isUniqueEmail
methods.description: Checks if the provided email is unique among employees, excluding the current employee.

methods.name: isValidEmailRecipient
methods.description: Validates the format and characters of an email address.

methods.name: saveContactDetails
methods.description: Aggregates input parameters, validates the emails, and updates the employee's contact details.
